description.value:
You can spend one use of your Channel Divinity as part of the same Bonus Action you use to enter your Crescent Dance to enhance it further. Choose one of the following benefits. You gain the chosen benefit for the duration of your Crescent Dance.

Dance Partner. You can cast Spiritual Weapon as part of the same Bonus Action if you know it, expending a spell slot as normal. If you do so, its damage die becomes a d12 and it critically hits on a 19 or 20.

Grace. You add your Wisdom modifier to Dexterity Saving Throws and when you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity Saving Throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the Saving Throw, and only half damage if you fail.

Swiftness. Your Speed increases by an additional 10 feet and you don't provoke attacks of opportunity when you move out of an enemy's reach.
